figures.name: Zeus

ability.name: Thunderbolt Edict
ability.description: Stun one enemy and reduce all enemy stats by 1 for 2 turns.

figures.description: King of the Olympians who rules from Mount Olympus and enforces divine law with his lightning bolt.

figures.name: Athena

ability.name: Aegis Shield
ability.description: Negate the next attack targeting any ally; grant +2 wisdom to that ally.

figures.description: Virgin goddess of wisdom and strategic warfare, born fully armored from Zeus's head.

figures.name: Poseidon

ability.name: Earth-Shaker
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies; 50% chance to stun each one for 1 turn.

figures.description: Temperamental lord of the seas whose wrath triggers earthquakes and storms.

figures.name: Hades

ability.name: Helm of Invisibility
ability.description: Make one ally invisible for 2 turns; enemy cannot target that ally.

figures.description: Stern ruler of the dead who rarely leaves his underground kingdom of shades.

figures.name: Apollo

ability.name: Silver Bow
ability.description: Deal 5 ranged damage ignoring defense; heal one ally for 3.

figures.description: God of the sun, arts and prophecy who can both afflict and cure disease.

figures.name: Artemis

ability.name: Moonsilver Arrow
ability.description: Deal 6 damage to one enemy; enemy cannot use special abilities next turn.

figures.description: Twin sister of Apollo and fierce protector of wild animals and young women.

figures.name: Hermes

ability.name: Winged Sandals
ability.description: Swap positions with any card on the field; steal one enemy buff.

figures.description: Divine messenger and trickster who guides souls to the underworld and aids heroes.

figures.name: Ares

ability.name: Battle Frenzy
ability.description: Gain +3 power for 2 turns; take double damage during this effect.

figures.description: God of raw bloodlust and war whose violence even the other gods find distasteful.

figures.name: Aphrodite

ability.name: Golden Apple
ability.description: Force one enemy to attack its own ally for 1 turn.

figures.description: Irresistible goddess of love whose beauty sparked the Trojan War.

figures.name: Hephaestus

ability.name: Divine Forgefire
ability.description: Equip one ally with a divine weapon granting +3 power for the battle.

figures.description: Lame divine smith who crafts weapons and armor for gods and heroes alike.

figures.name: Dionysus

ability.name: Sacred Frenzy
ability.description: Inflict ecstasy on all enemies: they attack randomly for 2 turns.

figures.description: God of wine and divine madness who transforms followers into frenzied maenads.

figures.name: Demeter

ability.name: Harvest Boon
ability.description: Restore 4 HP to all allies; if an ally is at 0 HP restore them to 2.

figures.description: Goddess of the grain whose grief over Persephone created the seasons.

figures.name: Herakles

ability.name: Twelve Labors
ability.description: This card ignores all negative status effects for the duration of the battle.

figures.description: Greatest of Greek heroes who completed twelve impossible tasks and ascended to godhood.

figures.name: Achilles

ability.name: Aristeia
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one target; this card loses 2 defense permanently after use.

figures.description: Near-invincible Trojan War hero whose single vulnerable heel sealed his tragic fate.

figures.name: Prometheus

ability.name: Stolen Fire
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 magic for the rest of the battle; this card takes 3 damage.

figures.description: Titan who defied Zeus to gift fire and civilization to humanity and suffered eternal torment.

figures.name: Typhon

ability.name: Hundredfold Assault
ability.description: Deal 2 damage to all enemies five times in one turn.

figures.description: Most fearsome monster ever born, father of all monsters, who nearly dethroned Zeus himself.

figures.name: Medusa

ability.name: Stone Gaze
ability.description: Petrify one enemy for 2 turns; that enemy cannot act or be healed.

figures.description: Once-beautiful Gorgon whose gaze turns living beings to stone and whose blood births monsters.

figures.name: Cerberus

ability.name: Three-Headed Watch
ability.description: Prevent any enemy from fleeing or using escape abilities; deal 2 damage each turn.

figures.description: Three-headed hound who guards the entrance to the underworld, allowing entry but never exit.

figures.name: Chimera

ability.name: Tri-Form Breath
ability.description: Deal fire damage 3, then poison damage 2, then bite damage 2 to one enemy.

figures.description: Fire-breathing hybrid of lion, goat and serpent who terrorized Lycia until slain by Bellerophon.

figures.name: Minotaur

ability.name: Labyrinth Charge
ability.description: Deal 6 damage and push target to the back row; target is confused for 1 turn.

figures.description: Half-man half-bull monster imprisoned in the Cretan labyrinth, fed on human sacrifices.
